item.title: Dynamical quantum simulations as laboratories for quantum information
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Su Yeon Chang, Hailey S. Murray, Brian Barch, Greeshma Oruganti, Luis Pedro García-Pintos, Martin Larocca, Mark M. Wilde, M. Cerezo
arXiv:2610.37589v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dynamical quantum simulations are commonly designed to access a particular response function or correlation function. Yet the underlying protocol prepares a family of many-body states that contains information well beyond the observable for which the simulation was originally designed. In this work, we explore the idea of using these states as laboratories for quantum information. As a case study, we consider the local-pulse protocols used to compute Green functions in finite XX and XXX spin chains, and we interpret opposite source rotations as encoding a classical bit into the many-body system. item.title: 基于无限维MEAT的离散调制连续变量量子密钥分发无条件安全性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Lars Kamin, Ian George, John Burniston, Florian Kanitschar
离散调制连续变量量子密钥分发（DM CV-QKD）在量子密码学中具有实验吸引力，但长期以来缺乏针对相干攻击的完整可组合有限尺寸安全性证明。本研究首次为DM CV-QKD协议建立了完整的可组合有限尺寸安全性证明，涵盖了不完美探测器以及固定和可变长度协议变体。该证明引入了无限维边际约束熵累积定理（iMEAT）和严格的降维技术，解决了这一长期存在的难题。

item.title: A Counterexample to the Optimality Conjecture in Convex Quantum Channel Optimization
item.description:
📚 Quantum
👤 Jianting Yang
Quantum 10, 2253 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-28-2253 This paper presents a counterexample to the optimality conjecture for the trace distance based optimal state transformation problem proposed by Coutts et al. [Quantum 5, 448 (2021)]. The conjecture posits that for the trace distance based optimal state transformation problem, applying the sign function to the error matrix uniquely determines a dual certificate for every optimal solution. By constructing a counterexample in 2-dimensional Hilbert spaces, we disprove this conjecture.

item.title: Entangling distant qubits via flying photons under thermal noise protected by multi-time-bin encoding
item.description:
📚 Quantum Science and Technology
👤 Jing Wu, Changqing Wang, Andrew Cameron, Yao Lu and Silvia Zorzetti
Entangling distant stationary qubits—such as superconducting qubits, color centers, trapped ions, and phononic modes—commonly relies on flying photons transmitted through noisy channels. The fidelity of remote entanglement is severely degraded by channel noise. While entanglement purification can theoretically mitigate this effect, its practical implementation in quantum networks is limited by the overhead of local operations and classical communication. We propose a multi-time-bin encoding scheme that improves the fidelity of remote entangled stationary qubits without relying on entanglement purification. arXiv:2610.35931v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a frustrated seam produced by literal reflection gluing of Wen's plaquette model on a closed lattice Klein bottle. item.title: 面向量子LDPC码的不确定性感知和可泛化神经解码
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xiangjun Mi, Frank Mueller
量子纠错（QEC）对于可扩展量子计算至关重要，但传统算法的解码错误导致准确性有限且开销高，而推理型解码器可以缓解这些问题。然而，目前的机器学习解码器缺乏实际容错所需的两个关键特性：可靠的不确定性量化和对未见QEC码的鲁棒泛化能力。为解决此问题，本研究提出了一种量子贝叶斯图注意力解码器（QuBA），可实现富有表现力的错误模式识别和校准后的不确定性估计。在此基础上，进一步开发了多阶段训练框架SAGU（Sequential Aggregate Generalization under Uncertainty），以增强跨域鲁棒性。在双变量自行车（BB）码及其互素变体上的实验表明，QuBA始终优于经典基线置信传播（BP），在置信决策下可将逻辑错误率（LER）降低多达两个数量级。
